title: Costco brings Uber Eats delivery to new US locations
description:

title: #240: How David’s Bridal Is Rebuilding a 76-Year-Old Business Around AI
description:
David's Bridal was built around one thing for 75 years: the dress. In this AI Transformations episode, Elina Vilk (President & Chief Business Officer) and Mike Ball (Head of Product) join Mike Kaput to explain how the company is reinventing itself around the whole wedding journey, the "aisle to algorithm" strategy.

We get into Pearl Planner, the free AI wedding-planning companion now used by hundreds of thousands of couples with no marketing spend; Pearl Connect, the new vendor-side platform built on Google Cloud; the vision quiz and dynamic budgeting that make it work; and how David's own teams are adopting AI internally. Presented by Gemini Enterprise.

Part of the AI Transformations series, presented by Google Cloud.

title: Eight Agencies Take a New Approach to AI-Powered Marketing
description:
The agency model is being rewritten in real time.
 
A growing gap is emerging between those embracing artificial intelligence and those sticking with the status quo. 
 
The most forward-thinking agencies aren’t simply adding AI to existing services. They’re reimagining what an agency can be, developing AI-powered systems, expanding into consulting, and finding entirely new ways to deliver strategy, creative, technology, and operations.
 
Below, we explore several emerging agency models and services, along with how they could help your business move forward.
 
Disclaimer: We’re featuring these agencies because they’re all MAICON (Marketing AI Conference) sponsors. They represent some of the interesting ways AI is expanding what’s possible in marketing. If any of these interest you, they will be onsite at MAICON in the expo hall to talk to you about your work, challenges, and opportunities.
